calendarNotConfigured: Google Calendar has not been configured on this server.
calendarNotConnected: Connect Google Calendar before selecting or syncing calendars.
calendarInvalidState: This Google Calendar connection attempt has expired or is invalid. Start again.
calendarInvalidToken: Google Calendar authorization expired or was rejected. Reconnect your account.
calendarProviderUnavailable: Google Calendar is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
calendarInvalidSnapshot: Google Calendar returned an incomplete or invalid result. Your saved events were preserved.
calendarConflict: The selection limit was reached or the connection changed. Refresh and try again.
googleCalendarSelectionNotFound: That calendar or selection is not available to your account.
